A.title: Mouldering Stair
A.text: The stair is slick with growth and the rail will not hold you. Test each step with the butt of your spear. A hunter's notch says: green is rot, white is rotten through.

Y.title: The Ring of Caps
Y.text: The caps sway though there is no wind. Their undersides glow, and the glow is brightest where something died. Do not stand in the ring at night.

R.title: The Herbalist's Diary
R.text: Entry forty: a poultice of bark and ash turns the flesh against rot. The skin hardens and spores slide off. I tried it and I am still here.

G.title: Vault of the Spores
G.text: Seal and guardians, all grown over. The herbalist who built it called the spores by name. I do not know the names. I know the vault is full.

M.title: The Quiet Web
M.text: White threads under the floor, running everywhere. Step on one and the floor remembers you. Move lightly and it forgets faster.

O.title: An Old Sigh
O.text: The air in this room leaves the wall in slow breaths. A hunter wrote: the wall is alive. I put my hand to it and it was warm.

U.title: Muttering in the Spores
U.text: The spores make a sound like talk if you stay too long. Wear a cloth over your face. The ones who did not are the ones who mutter now.

X.title: Pages of Toadstool
X.text: A book grown from toadstool flesh, the words pressed in by the spores themselves. It tells how the bloom began: something fell here, and it did not die.
